fragments.text: Welcome to Manham Port, where a thousand years of
are brought to life. All the family can enjoy a day out at Manham: visit our
, see models of the
it used, have your photo taken in costume, experience at first hand how people lived at
throughout history, and how children studied, worked and played.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 欢迎来到曼海姆港，这里千年的历史全部苏醒过来。所有的家庭都可以在曼海姆享受一天假期：参观我们的铜矿，看曾经使用的机器模型，穿着古代服饰拍照，直接感受历史上不同时期人们如何生活，以及孩子们如何学习、工作和玩耍。

fragments.text: The port of Manham is located in beautiful and peaceful

, on a bend in the great River Avon, and developed here because it's the highest point of the Avon - boats can go no higher up this river - and proved a handy place to load and unload cargo to and from the sea, which is over
away.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 曼海姆港坐落于漂亮安宁的乡间，在伟大的埃文河的一个拐弯处，由于这里是埃文河可以通航的最高点——船从这里不能继续向上游走了——所以曼海姆港在这里发展起来，经证明，这里是一个便于从23英里外的海边装货卸货的区域。

fragments.text: A small port was already established here when, about
, tin was discovered nearby, though it wasn't until the Industrial Revolution, when a need for metals of all kinds developed, that Manham expanded to become one of the busiest
in the country. And because it was already so busy,
began to look for other minerals, and by the end of the nineteenth century, lead, copper, manganese and arsenic were added to the
leaving Manham.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 大约900年前附近发现了锡，当时这里已经建立了一个小港口。但直到工业革命时期，对各种金属的需求增加，曼海姆才发展成全国最繁忙的港口之一。而且因为已经如此繁忙，探矿者开始寻找其他矿物，到19世纪末，铅、铜、锰和砷也加入了离开曼海姆的货物之列。

- in the same area they were mined. But, as demand grew, the smelting process required huge factory furnaces or fires to melt the
from the rock and there was not enough
in the local area, so the rocks containing
had to be shipped

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 早期，矿石在被开采的同一地区就被熔炼——或者说加工。但随着需求增长，冶炼过程需要大型工厂熔炉或大火来将金属从岩石中熔出，而当地没有足够的煤，因此含有矿物的岩石不得不被远距离运送。

fragments.text: Sadly, in the twentieth century, the great port of Manham
, and thousands of workers were forced to
out of the area. The building at the port
, and the place became almost forgotten.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 可悲的是，在20世纪，曼海姆大港衰落了，成千上万的工人被迫离开该地区移民。港口的建筑年久失修，这个地方几乎被遗忘。

fragments.text: But then, the Manham Trust was formed to conserve the
of the area. It organised
of local volunteers to remove underground
to find the original outlines of the
. It then brought in paid
to match installations with maps of the original port complex and to set about reconstructing it.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 但后来，曼海姆信托基金成立，以保护该地区的历史资源。它组织许多当地志愿者清除矮灌木丛，找出装置的原貌。然后它聘请了付费的专业人士，根据原始港口综合体的地图匹配设施，并着手重建。

fragments.text: Today you can see the results of this
of restoration. The intention, and we believe this will be realised before the end of the year, is to return Manham Port to the
it reached at its peak as 'the greatest copper port in the country'.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 今天，你可以看到这一雄心勃勃的修复项目的成果。我们相信，在今年年底前，我们将会实现目标，让曼海姆港恢复到其鼎盛时期的状况，成为‘全国最大的铜港’。

fragments.text: But what can you do and see on your visit today? Here are just a few
. We suggest you start with the visit to the copper mine. Travel on
mining trains and journey
of the mountain along seams once worked by hundreds of miners. Watch out especially for the great pumping machines which rid the mine of water.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 但是今天你们来这里可以做什么、看什么呢？以下是一些特色。我们建议你从参观铜矿开始。乘坐改装过的矿区火车，沿着深入大山的矿层开展一段旅程，这里曾经有几百名矿工在这里工作。特别留意看一下用于抽取矿区水分的巨大的泵。

fragments.text: But please be warned that, like all mines, ours is very
in and we do say that children under five and also dogs should NOT be taken into the mine.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 但是请注意，就像所有的矿区，我们的里面也很黑暗并且拥挤，所以我们特别建议五岁以下的儿童和狗是不应该带入矿区的。

fragments.text: The next
is to the village school. While looking round the classrooms, take a
at our
which is one of the largest in the world. And it's
that you time your visit to coincide with a guided tour. This will give you the opportunity to ask lots of questions.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 下一个推荐参观的是乡村学校。在参观教室的同时，请特别注意一下我们的游戏展示，这是世界上最大的之一。我们推荐你算好时间以便赶上这里的向导游。这样你就有机会问很多问题。

fragments.text: Near the school is the beautiful old sailing ketch called 'The George'. You are welcome to board the boat and look
. Look out for the ship's wheel which was missing until only
when it was dredged out of the silt by a local
. We have no idea how it got there but it's been polished and proudly restored to its
on the boat.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 学校附近是那艘名叫‘乔治号’的漂亮老帆船。欢迎您登上船四处参观。注意船舵，直到五年前才被当地渔民的从淤泥中挖出来，之前它一直失踪。我们不知道它是怎么到那里的，但它已经被擦亮并自豪地恢复了原来的位置。

fragments.text: Please take care going down the
if you wish to visit the lower deck - we don't
you allow young children to use them.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 如果您想参观下层甲板，下梯子时要小心——我们不建议让幼儿使用梯子。

fragments.text: So we hope you have a
to Manham Port and will tell your friends all about us.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 所以我们希望你们能在曼海姆港有一次难忘的参观，并且告诉你的朋友所有有关我们的事情。

title: Manham 港历史与旅游 (Manham Port history and tourism)
